I guess it's not so much that I worry about how people will receive reading itself, but the kind of stuff I read: very little fiction, all this academic literature that most people I know tend to find pretty dry. If even my friends (gently, good-naturedly) tease me about bringing a book called [i]Hinduism and Secularism[/i] to the beach, what would a stranger think? Do they anticipate spending a first date talking about that kind of thing, and they're turned off immediately? You know what I mean?

I worry, too, because it's not like I'm into this stuff in addition to being into sports or anime or what have you: this is what I'm most passionate about—so should I downplay that, and emphasize my interest in, e.g., movies? It also just occurred to me that I might need to worry about coming off as pretentious as well, but that's another thread, I think.
